title: Taken from the harvest (Nigeria mass kidnappings)
voice: Text-led: vo/ empty (ElevenLabs credits at 0 on 30 Sept 2026). Record 01-08.mp3 from the 'say' lines with voice nJvj5shg2xu1GKGxqfkE (09.mp3 = copy of ebola-blindspot-60s/vo/10.mp3) and re-render.

lines.say: She went out to harvest peanuts. Officials say she has now given birth in a kidnappers' camp.
lines.show: She went out to harvest peanuts. Officials say she has now given birth in a kidnappers' camp.

lines.say: Over one weekend in northern Nigeria, more than eighty people were kidnapped in two attacks. Most were women.
lines.show: Over one weekend in northern Nigeria, more than 80 people were kidnapped in two attacks. Most were women.

lines.say: In Niger State, a local official says forty-seven farmers were seized in the middle of the harvest.
lines.show: In Niger State, a local official says 47 farmers were seized in the middle of the harvest.

lines.say: In Zamfara, about forty women were taken. Residents say the gunmen stayed four hours, and no help came.
lines.show: In Zamfara, about 40 women were taken. Residents say the gunmen stayed 4 hours, and no help came.

lines.say: Now the kidnappers are demanding two million naira for every person they took.
lines.show: Now the kidnappers are demanding 2 million naira for every person they took.

lines.say: Ransoms paid to armed groups more than tripled in a year, to nearly six million dollars.
lines.show: Ransoms paid to armed groups more than tripled in a year, to nearly $6 million.
